productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Three final quests as Hiccup faces exile, betrayal, and a world-ending war between humans and dragons, with the future of both worlds resting on his next move._**

The story continues in the tenth, eleventh and twelfth volumes of Hiccup’s How to Train Your Dragon memoirs, read by David Tennant.  
  
  
  
  
In How to Seize a Dragon’s Jewel, things are getting very dark indeed. The Dragon Rebellion has begun. Snotlout is the new Chief of the Hooligan Tribe. Stoick has been banished and given the Slavemark. And Alvin the Treacherous has EIGHT of the King's Lost Things, and has been proclaimed the new King of the Wilderwest... But what can Hiccup do, now all alone and in exile, hunted by both humans and dragons? Can he find the Dragon Jewel, mankind's last and only hope? And if he does, what will he do with it?  
  
  
  
  
In How to Betray a Dragon’s Hero, high up in the treacherous mists of the Murderous Mountains, Hiccup and the Company of the Dragonmark are in hiding. The witch's Spydragons are guarding the shores of Tomorrow – but Hiccup is determined to become King of the Wilderwest. Can Hiccup dodge the dragons and steal the King's Things back from Alvin before the Doomsday of Yule? And is there a traitor in Hiccup's camp who in the end will betray them all?  
  
  
  
  
In How to Fight a Dragon’s Fury, it is the Doomsday of Yule. At the end of this day, either the humans or the dragons will face extinction. Alvin the Treacherous is about to be crowned the King of the Wilderwest on the island of Tomorrow. His reign of terror will begin with the destruction of dragons everywhere. Hiccup must fight the Dragon Furious and end the Rebellion... ALONE. As Doomsday draws to an end can Hiccup be the Hero of the hour? Will the dragons survive?

Tracks included:

*   About Hiccup

In How to Fight a Dragon’s Fury, it is the Doomsday of Yule. At the end of this day, either the humans or the dragons will face extinction. Alvin the Treacherous is about to be crowned the King of the Wilderwest on the island of Tomorrow. His reign of terror will begin with the destruction of dragons everywhere. Hiccup must fight the Dragon Furious and end the Rebellion... ALONE. As Doomsday draws to an end can Hiccup be the Hero of the hour? Will the dragons survive?
